links.outcome: Response consistency across three independent runs (Any Correct Rate, Full Correct Rate, Consistency Gap)
links.effect: Consistency Gap showed no association with parameter size but a nonlinear relationship with accuracy; no numeric values are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Consistency Gap showed no association with parameter size but demonstrated a nonlinear relationship with accuracy.

screen.reason: Evaluates 52 open-source small language models on Japanese National License Examination for Pharmacists questions to assess accuracy and consistency without testing specific deployment practices.
